# AbstractContinuum

> Continuous iterative development and deployment console for
> AbstractFramework (npm: `@abstractframework/continuum`, CLI:
> `abstractcontinuum`, version 0.4.0): a thin React client over a Run
> Gateway's development-lane APIs — kanban board, live execution pipeline
> (executor chosen by a gateway setting: codex, claude, cursor-agent,
> abstractcode), backlog catalog, agora hub Team
> page, report/email triage, and managed prod/UAT service control.
> High-trust surface: a signed-in user can redeploy services (see
> SECURITY.md).

Run it with `npx @abstractframework/continuum` against AbstractGateway
0.4.1 or newer (`--gateway-url`, default: the gateway installed on this
computer, else `http://127.0.0.1:8080`); it serves on
`http://127.0.0.1:3002`, and a gateway that manages it serves it at
`/apps/continuum/`. The server is configured with launch
flags or `abstractcontinuum config set` (settings file
`~/.abstractcontinuum/settings.json`; the hub seat is also on the Settings
page); the backlog folder, exec runner,
executor and process manager are gateway settings (Settings → Gateway
administration, or `abstractgateway config set`).

- [docs/security.md](docs/security.md): trust model, session/CSRF mechanics (and, with app-server 0.1.10 or newer, the `X-Forwarded-For` / `X-AbstractFramework-App-Proxy` headers the proxy sends), hub seat model, execution safety (UAT vs inplace)

- [docs/troubleshooting.md](docs/troubleshooting.md): sign-in, About showing the gateway unavailable, executions, backlog folder not available, inbox, services, Team page, dev setup

## Source Map

- bin/cli.js: CLI server — static serving, gateway session proxy, hub proxy mount, `config` command
- bin/settings.js: server settings registry, flag > settings file > environment (legacy) > default, Settings route
- bin/hub_proxy.js: allowlisted agora hub proxy (HTTP + WebSocket)
- src/lib/gateway_client.ts: typed gateway client (dev-lane families only)
- src/lib/hub_client.ts: agora hub client; vendor/hub/ holds the pinned hub contract
- src/ui/board/: kanban board; src/ui/backlog/: backlog + exec pipeline (model.ts is pure + unit-pinned)
- src/ui/backlog_folder.tsx: backlog folder states (empty Board, folder not available + admin actions)
- src/ui/settings_page.tsx: Settings, including the hub seat and Gateway administration
- src/ui/team_page.tsx: Team page; src/ui/executions_page.tsx, agents_page.tsx, report_inbox.tsx, email_inbox.tsx, processes_page.tsx (Services): other pages
